briefdescription.para: Engine-side Z/p ring for small primes (p < 32767), using a discrete-log (Zech) representation.

detaileddescription.para:
Stores non-zero elements as their exponent indices relative to a primitive root, with _ZERO = p-1 reserved as the encoding of
Holds two size-P tables (_exp_table, _log_table) for hop-to-residue / hop-back conversions, and bundles a CoefficientRingZZp and ARingZZp facade so the same ring can appear under either coefficient interface. The int_to_exp / to_int helpers convert between the internal index world and the externally visible residue.
